name: Cameras
summary: Camera modules and image sensors from CCTV, webcams, phones, doorbells and trail cameras.
uses: Watching a perimeter with a CCTV camera and a screen
identify: Small lens modules on ribbon cables in phones, laptops and doorbells; boxed CCTV cameras on buildings, often ringed with IR LEDs for night. Disposable and film cameras hold a flash capacitor charged to about 300V: discharge it before touching the board.
test: Power it and look at the picture: analogue CCTV plugs into any TV’s yellow video input, and USB webcams work on any computer. Cover the lens to check the IR night mode switches on.
